title: Download complete bounded matched report results through universal exporters
description: Customer explicitly downloads current page or complete bounded matched result as Excel/PDF in common configuration workspace; use existing universal endpoint/exporters, no dataset-specific controller or renderer. For full-match download, acquire one existing per-user execution lease/deadline and obtain fresh server-authorized snapshot <=1000 facts/8MiB; same snapshot feeds facts and all-selected-summary/group/pivot values. One dedicated server-internal export result contract separates up-to1000 facts from <=200-row ordinary preview; don't raise ordinary preview limit, grant another lease or accept client rows. Revalidate saved/pinned/granted definition and recipient field/menu/data scope, relation/formula inputs and final revocation before sending response. Old downloads remain current-page unless full selection explicitly chosen and authorized snapshot capability advertised. Finite selected columns/order/typed values/formula-safe text/Chinese font, unknown counts/currency partitions, definition/version/query/sort/grain/matched-count/coverage evidence preserved. Render bounded rows/pages/column bands incrementally with cancellation checks and total output <=10MiB; overcap, font missing, byte/deadline limit or permission loss returns no partial file and clear correlation/error. No runtime temporary data files/storage or retained cross-request snapshot; memory/streams disposed on all outcomes. Whole-match totals must correspond exactly to exported facts, never page subset mislabeled as all. UI states both modes and preserved edits/retry/late-response safeguards. Offline exported workbook/PDF fixtures compare 250+ facts beyond first preview page, selected metrics/pivot, empty/unknown/negative/currency and1001rejection; safe build/test required and real DB/browser marked environment blocked. Stage 1 unified platform only; existing sales-order/receivable adapters are engine fixtures, not migration or new bespoke reports. Preserve old report entries until every fixed/dynamic report passes Stage 2 parity. No Agent or cross-business flow work. Server-authenticated identity and fresh existing menu/field/row/data scope remain authoritative, saved definitions/grants never grant ERP permissions. No arbitrary SQL, scripts, joins, tables, mixed currency/unit totals or one-to-many header duplication. No migrations, SchemaUpgrader/SeedData modifications, production SQL/database execution, schema/view/procedure changes, secrets/.env/config changes, deployment or irreversible operations. Use existing HTTP and entity audit conventions. Safe build/test and relevant offline integration tests required; missing actual DB/browser/font environment must be explicitly blocked, never claim the phase complete from build. Preserve unrelated source/work.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh generic export coverage uses one bounded snapshot and execution lease, separate internal export contract and final recipient rights checks without changing preview/default limits.
Universal Excel/PDF include all complete <=1000 matched facts or matrix and matching totals/evidence with correct types/nulls/currency, cancellation and10MiB cap; no partial file.
Workspace explicitly selects page/full coverage and handles failure without stale downloads; offline beyond-page/limit/render/revocation tests pass safe build/test.
